Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 56740 of 2022
Applicant :- Rohit

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Dubey,Abhinav Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard Sri Ram Milan Dwivedi, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Abhinav Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
There is delay in lodging FIR as the incident was allegedly occurred on 13.5.2022 and the FIR was lodged on 14.5.2022.
As per allegation levelled against the applicant in the FIR, the applicant enticed the victim on false assurance of marriage.
The age of the victim is above 18 years.
The statement of the victim was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and she has not supported the prosecution case.
There are contradictions in the statements of victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
It is further submitted that the victim is major and is consenting party.
The applicant is in jail since 21.9.2022 and if released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

1
On the other hand, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail, but could not dispute the aforesaid fact.

Considering the submission of learned counsel for the parties, facts of the case, nature of allegation and period of custody, gravity of offence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let applicant- Rohit be released on bail in Case Crime No.255 of 2022, under Sections 366, 376 IPC,
Police Station Katghar, District Moradabad on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

Order Date :- 20.2.2023 P.P.
